speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Frontotemporal Dementia with secondary parkinsonism or rapidly progressive dementia (e.g., Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease) due to the combination of subacute cognitive decline, behavioral changes, and focal motor deficits in a 44-year-old.
